Figure 2. Comparison of Existing CLIP-based Few-shot Methods. We only show the training-required model variants of prior-based methods and our APE-T. EV , ET denote CLIP’s pre-trained visual and textual encoders, respectively.

Figure 4. The Effectiveness of Prior Reﬁnement Module, which minimizes the inter-class visual similarity and improves the text-image alignment.

Figure 5. Framework of APE. Based on the prior reﬁnement (PR), APE explores trilateral relations of vision-language repre- sentations in a training-free manner.
Figure 6. Framework of APE-T. Our training-required variant appends learnable category residuals along with RF ′W ′ on top of APE for few-shot training.
